app.home_tagline: Tested Windows recipes for Linux · Proton-GE
app.home_intro: Welcome. Pick a recipe on the left to install, validate, or launch. Rezeptor uses Proton-GE only — no system Wine fallbacks.
app.home_tip: Tip: F5 refreshes status for all recipes. Help opens the handbook.
app.home_link_wiki_tip: Open the public documentation in your browser
app.home_link_reddit_tip: Open a user report on Reddit — support via GitHub only

update.flatpak_manual:
Update Flatpak outside Rezeptor:

1. Open the release page
2. Download rezeptor-{latest}-x86_64.flatpak
3. Run: flatpak install --user -y --reinstall rezeptor-{latest}-x86_64.flatpak

Then restart Rezeptor.
update.none_body:
Channel: {channel}

Version v{current} is up to date{latest_hint}.
update.failed_flatpak:
Automatic Flatpak update is not available inside the app (exit {code}).

Update Flatpak manually:

1. Open the release page
2. Download rezeptor-{latest}-x86_64.flatpak
3. flatpak install --user -y --reinstall rezeptor-{latest}-x86_64.flatpak

Then restart Rezeptor.

settings.title: Settings

Rezeptor will verify the install status of all recipes (validate.sh).

dialog.about_body:
Tested Wine recipes — Install, Launch, Validate, Repair.

Project: github.com/{repo}

License: GPL-2.0

Copyright © 2024–2026 Sunny C.
dialog.quit_busy_body: An operation is still running. Quit Rezeptor anyway?
dialog.quit_windows_body: Other Rezeptor windows are still open. Quit Rezeptor anyway?
dialog.quit_dirty_extra: Unsaved changes in secondary windows will be lost.
dialog.version_help:
Recipes support install and launch only with the stated, tested version (healing).

• Tested healing: verified by the recipe author
• Custom/other versions: may work, but are untested and unsupported
• Issues with other versions come from the version choice, not the recipe

Use the version documented by the recipe for tested healing.
dialog.wine_dialogs_body:
Wine windows may appear during install or repair.

Rezeptor shows in the step which window is meant:

• “Wine Mono installer” → click Install (do not Cancel)
• “Updating Wine configuration” → click OK or wait briefly

The current action is shown under Steps and in the progress line.
dialog.wine_dialogs_activity: Wine windows may appear briefly — please click OK or Install.
dialog.failure_info: See log files. Issues can be reported on GitHub.
dialog.report_confirm:
Create a sanitized log report and open a GitHub issue?

(Paths/emails are anonymized)
dialog.report_opened_body:
The issue form uses the official bug template.

1. In the browser: briefly fill in “Problem” and “Actual behavior”
2. Logs are already formatted — paste with Ctrl+V into “📸 Logs”

Report file: {name}
dialog.install_reconfirm:
“{name}” is already set up.

Choose source/target again and run installation?
(Wine prefix stays; portable can be copied to a new target folder.)
dialog.update_body:
Apply update packages now?

Numbered folders (1 - …, 2 - …) run in order; already applied updates are skipped.
dialog.relocate_body:
Move “{name}” from
{old}
to
{new}?

All data (including the prefix) will be moved. Shortcuts and paths are updated.

Ensure enough free space at the destination and that the program is not running.
dialog.relocate_same: New target is the same as the current one — nothing to do.
dialog.relocate_need_target: Please choose a new target folder.
dialog.relocate_running: Please quit the program first (More → Quit), then move again.
dialog.genp_body:
Launch GenP from the pack under Wine?

1. Check Photoshop
2. Click the Pill (Cure)
3. In the filename field Ctrl+V (path is on the clipboard) → Open

GenP picks the start folder itself — we cannot pre-select it.
Only needed if activation dropped (ISO is pre-patched).
dialog.repair_wiso:
Repair runs validate.sh and fills in what’s missing:
• Portable root / launch script
• vcrun2019, gdiplus, dotnet48 (Wine Mono), win10

Wine windows may appear briefly — please click OK or Install.

Continue?
dialog.repair_default:
Repair runs validate.sh and fixes:
• Native MSXML
• Fonts (ClearType/Segoe UI)
• Proton-GE graphics DLLs
• Desktop icon (only if already created)

Continue?
dialog.uninstall_confirm:
Uninstall “{name}”?

This permanently deletes the Wine prefix and recipe data under the chosen data folder (and Rezeptor’s copy under ~/.local/share/wine-software/). Desktop shortcuts for this recipe are removed.

Game/portable folders outside that data folder are left alone.

This cannot be undone.
dialog.shortcuts_body:
Create “{name}” in the application/start menu and on the Desktop?

The icon comes from the recipe.

No / later: anytime under More → “Add or update shortcuts…”.
dialog.shortcuts_created:
Start-menu and desktop shortcuts created.

Create or refresh again (e.g. after deleting): More → “Add or update shortcuts…”.
dialog.shortcuts_failed: Could not create shortcuts. Check the log.
dialog.shortcuts_later: Add shortcuts later: More → Add or update shortcuts…
dialog.launch_already: “{name}” was already running (possibly hidden) — Quit, then Launch again
dialog.launch_tips_wiso:
Rezeptor → WISO → Repair (sets wined3d + Qt launch fix).
First start can take 10–20 s — check the Log tab.
Linux internet stays active; only one WISO Qt plugin is disabled.
dialog.launch_tips_default: Quit → Launch again, or Repair. Check the Log tab.

source.label: Source

source.pick_update_kind: Update source: folder, file (.exe / .iso), or archive?
source.game_pick_kind: Game source: ISO file, pack folder (with .iso), or installer folder?
source.clear_tip: Clear the field — then close with OK or Cancel
source.adobe_pick_kind: Adobe source: ISO file, pack folder (with .iso), or folder with Set-up.exe?
source.portable_ph: Freely chosen folder — portable software lands here
source.data_root_ph: Freely chosen folder — game/app + prefix land here
source.steam_auto_hint: Target is detected from Steam (AppID) — editable.
source.steam_link_hint: Steam game folder — online fix may already be inside or chosen separately.
source.folder_tip: Folder with the software (portable, game folder, offline-installer folder)
source.archive_tip: Archive; for multipart pick the first file (.001 / .part01). Passwords: global list
source.target_tip: Location for the game/app — freely chosen; Rezeptor wires the prefix underneath
source.target_help: The software will live under this folder (for Wine including the prefix). Rezeptor sets paths so launch/repair keep working.
source.primary_info_body: Folder, archive, or installer — depends on the recipe. Rezeptor does not distribute game files; you bring your own source (BYOS).
source.installer_source_info_body: Folder with Set-up.exe or an ISO file. Rezeptor extracts or mounts when needed and runs the installer in the Wine prefix.
source.steam_link_info_body:
The folder containing the game .exe (e.g. Steam → Manage → Browse local files).

Rezeptor links the folder — nothing is copied. For online-fix games, fix files may already be in the folder or you pick them separately in the “Online fix” field.
source.space_hint: Make sure there is enough free disk space.
source.updates_none: No updates under the source (updates/ or 1 - … folders).
source.updates_fix_none: Update/Fix field set — check the folder layout.
source.updates_info_body:
If the source contains folders like updates/1 - … or updates/<name>/1 - … (with .exe), Rezeptor applies them automatically after install when the recipe supports it.

You can also pick a separate update pack in the Update / Fix field — e.g. when patches are not inside the install pack.

Later: More → Apply update…
source.updates_info_tip: Short help about updates and folder layout
source.updates_layout_hint: Updates inside the install pack: under the source, folder updates/ with 1 - …, 2 - … (each with .exe) — all are detected automatically and installed in order. The Update / Fix field is only for patches outside the pack (optional).
source.online_fix_info_body:
Separate folder with fix files (.dll, .ini) you provide yourself — Rezeptor does not ship fixes.

On install, files are copied into a subfolder of the game (path is in the recipe, e.g. …/Binaries/Win64).

If files are already in the chosen game folder, this field can stay empty.
source.passwords_tip: Same global list as Settings → Archive passwords.
source.version_none: No version guarantee for this recipe.
source.version_unknown: Tested healing: {guaranteed} — source version not detected (may differ).
source.hints_note: Search keywords only — Rezeptor provides no download links. Bring your own source (BYOS).
source.passwords_hint: Same as Settings → Archive passwords. One line = one password.
source.password_ask_body: “{name}” is protected. Enter the password — it will be saved to the global list.
source.password_wrong: Wrong password — try again or cancel.
source.need_source: Please choose a source (folder or archive).
source.need_fix: A fix package is required for this recipe.
source.need_online_fix: An online-fix folder is required for this recipe.
source.saved_ready: Source and target saved — click “Install” to continue.
source.cleared: Source/target cleared — install needs a source again.

recipe_remove.title: Remove recipe definition
recipe_remove.confirm:
Delete folder “{path}”?

This only removes recipe files in the repo — not install data under ~/.local/share/wine-software/.

Bundled official recipes cannot be removed this way.
recipe_remove.blocked_official: “{id}” is an official recipe and cannot be removed here.

hidden.title: Hidden recipes
hidden.intro: Hidden recipes are absent from the sidebar — install data stays. Uninstall is separate.
